affected_component: Repository analyzer secret-environment scan (admission measurement layer)
invariant: Admission required-secret findings must originate from executable environment reads (AST Load-context subscripts of os.environ or its imported aliases) discovered by a deterministic full-tree scan. String literals, documentation mentions, environment assignments and upstream test/example/doc-zone reads are not runtime requirements of the adopted capability and must be reported separately instead of hard-blocking; genuine executable reads in runtime code still block. A generic per-file scan cap must never shape the secret verdict in either direction (false block by alphabetical order, or silent miss beyond the cap).
